title: NightML's Skull Totem
description: Minecraft Totems of Undying are now skulls with blue energy around them.
body:
# NightML's Skull Totem
## Part of the 15 Totems Collection

Have you ever thought that for a death-saving item, like the Totem of Undying to look so simple is like a crime? Well, I certainly hadn't until I was writing that.

But! I really thought a skull design totem would be gothic, niche, and cool, all at the same time. It also has blue energy that appears like it is around it.

### Several Minecraft versions
It works for Minecraft versions 26.0 (and likely further). Be aware that in most versions, a warning may appear that it is for the wrong version, but as long as you are using it in 1.21.8 or later - it should work, so no worries.

## Created by NightML, aka NightMareLore. 

Taking suggestions for resourcepacks via email: nightmarelore.10@gmail.com
